text:
Maya: heads up — opened a small PR to the reserved capacity handbook with examples and a couple wording tweaks for autoscale policies. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123
Rohan: looking now. do we need to call out eviction vs preemption explicitly in the SLA section?
Maya: yeah, I softened the SLA language but left an options table. want clearer examples for when autoscale will burst to shared vs reserved pools.
Samir: can you add a tiny terraform snippet showing tenant reservation + isolation flag? fastest way to get code reviewers to click. e.g. ```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "team_a" {
  name = "team-a-pool"
  capacity_gpus = 8
  isolation = "tenant"
}
```
Elaine: also add a Console link to the per-route SLO dashboard. folks kept asking where to check observed latency. I can paste the URL in the PR.
Jen: quick nit: one of the links in the migration guide 404s (old terraform guide). can someone fix that target to the new CLI section?
Maya: thanks — I'll update the link. also reworked the autoscale example to show min/max pods and burst policy shorthand. snippet included in PR.
Rohan: wording suggestion for SLA paragraph: replace "best effort" with "no SLA for burst capacity" and mention fallback ordering (reserved -> dedicated -> shared). short and explicit.
Samir: question on isolation semantics: if we set `isolation = "tenant"` does that block evictions entirely or just prefer reserved allocation? docs should clarify eviction priority matrix.
Elaine: confirmed from infra: tenant isolation sets allocation preference; eviction still possible under host-level resource pressure. will add a one-liner and link to the eviction matrix in runtime docs.
Maya: perfect. Jen, want to take final pass after those edits?
Jen: yup. also propose moving the SDK snippet into a separate short file under examples/ so the handbook stays narrative and the code is easy to copy.
doc-bot: checklist generated — [docs PR checklist] broken links, code samples in examples/, add Console URL, update SLA wording, add eviction matrix link.
Maya: okay I'll split the SDK/Terraform examples into examples/ and push edits tonight. thanks all :thumbsup:
Rohan: leaving one more comment inline about terminology (reserved vs dedicated) to avoid mixing the terms in the same paragraph.
Samir: ack, will review the example file next hour.
Elaine: pasted Console dashboard URL in the PR comments.
Jen: once Samir + Rohan approve, I'll merge and backport to v1.3 handbook.
Maya: lovely. closing loop here — will ping again when merged. :rocket:
